fact: The COMESA IDEA half-year report says Angola's IMA completed the Interoperability Framework study and its platform roadmap in January-June 2026, the basis for procuring the interoperability platform; it does not say the framework was adopted.
system: Interoperability Framework and roadmap (Quadro e Roteiro de Interoperabilidade)

fact: IMA's terms of reference say a seven-month study with 25 public institutions produced the Framework and Roadmap of Interoperability, with organisational, semantic, technical and infrastructure guidelines and a phased roadmap; the document gives no adoption instrument. Dated by the document's publication date, 2026-02-09.
system: Quadro e Roteiro de Interoperabilidade da Administração Pública

fact: The same study found only 27% of systems interconnected across the 25 institutions, mostly point-to-point, with fragmented governance and no common standards; the document names no decree making the framework compulsory. Dated by the document's publication date, 2026-02-09.
